| Sample | Result |
|--------|--------|
| S-01   | Pass   |
| S-02   | Fail   |
| S-03   | Pass   |

$a + b = c$

$a - b = d$

Then compare another table.

| Code | Description  |
|------|--------------|
| A1   | Left branch  |
| B2   | Right branch |

Finish in the same reading order.
